notes: WP-E (14-WPE-paint): paint the browser paints. The 6 x 4 grid of boxes.html — 160 x 110 cells at
Row 1, colours: every modern syntax resolves to RRGGBB + alpha through color.js (color-mix in srgb 12 % of
the accent over white is E4F3EB); the gradient of a color-mix and an oklch stop has 2 stops, the first CEDEEF,
and one info diagnostic (the browser interpolates it in oklab). 6 shapes, 1 text.
Row 2, gradient text: no slab anywhere; each clipped gradient is the run's own fill in
extras['x-wpe-run-fills'] and the run colour is the gradient's middle (157D84; FFFFFF for the 3-stop one);
a clipped solid background is simply the run colour; only the span that clips is affected; clip:text over
a url() background is the one declared raster. 5 texts, 1 raster.
Row 3, ::before/::after rebuilt as real elements (10 of them): the axis line and dot are 2 shapes; the three
counter circles are 3 roundRect shapes with texts 1/2/3 beside ONE text element of three paragraphs (an
out-of-flow pseudo never splits a paragraph run); attr() and quotes join their paragraph as text
('→ Q3 Revenue', '“Quoted”'); content:none and an empty clearfix produce nothing; a block ::before in a flex
row splits the flow as a real block child does (a 24 x 24 shape and the 'Legend' text). 7 shapes, 8 texts.
Row 4, CSS border joins: zero-box triangles are exact 3-point custom paths (tri-right M40,546 L40,530
L54,538 Z; tri-up M255,542 L235,542 L245,530 Z; the chevron tip M550,570 L550,530 L570,550 Z), two painted
sides meeting are trapezoids, a transparent side written oklch(0 0 0 / 0) paints nothing. 10 shapes.
Row 5, opacity (r1d and r1e, plan 16 #27-#28; r1d's probe cells a1, b1, c1, c4), four 280 x 36 cells in the band
between rows 2 and 3, y = 330, x = 40/335/630/925 (not at the canvas's bottom: the layout's date, footer and
number zones are there, y 667-706, and the gate masks them). opacity-0-text: a positioned div at opacity 0 stays
in the file, its text at alpha 0 (it was written opaque: `_write_run` read `opacity or 1.0`). contents-chip: a
detached chip under a display:contents wrapper at 0.2 is drawn at full colour (the wrapper generates no box, so
fades nothing; measured in Edge) and its text is judged against its paragraph, not the wrapper's zero rect (a
false 'the box is 0 px tall' text-overflow warn, and the runner fails a family on any unlisted one).
inline-half: a span's own opacity 0.5 is on its slab as on its text (the slab was opaque). mark-around-chip: a
0.5 mark painted around a detached chip is at 0.5, and so is the chip. 4 shapes, 8 texts. The export fades each
shape and its text separately where the browser fades the group once (r1a's known gap), so white text over a
faded slab is fainter than in the browser: that is most of the row's area.
PptxRender draws a run gradFill as its first stop (renderer gap, the file is correct): the gate number of
this family carries that gap; PowerPoint draws the gradient.
gateMaxPx2 8,713 = 7,261 px2 masked measured 2026-09-25 (G-1's reference in Calibri / Calibri Light) + 20 %
(plan 16 #14, provisional until G-2 and H re-set every ceiling). 6,608 px2 of it is row 2's gradient text, all
drawn by PptxRender in the first stop (the same export with every run written as its solid mid-colour
measures 6,123: no single colour matches a gradient); 653 px2 is flex-block-before's 'Legend' text placed
from the row's content box, over its square (F2d, the side-by-side package's hug rule).

gateMaxPx2 7,930 = max(measured x 1.2, measured + 60) over the measured 6,608 px2 masked non-chart area on fidelity-w3 (2314d7f), 2026-09-25 (plan §11; Peter #16: measured + 20 %, with the 60 px2 per-slide noise tolerance as the floor). A regression guard, not a target.

gateMaxPx2 10,358 = max(measured x 1.2, measured + 60) over the measured 8,632 px2 masked non-chart area with row 5 on fidelity/r1e-opacity-rest (main d1d4c2a + r1e), 2026-09-25 (plan 16 #28). Rows 1-4 are unchanged at 6,608 px2; row 5 adds 2,024: 1,640 the chip inside the 0.5 mark and 246 the white 'half' over its 0.5 slab (the group opacity approximated per shape, above), 138 anti-aliasing. A regression guard, not a target.

gateMaxPx2 10,359 = max(measured x 1.2, measured + 60) over the measured 8,632 px2 masked non-chart area on fidelity r3 (37aae73), 2026-09-25 (plan §11; Peter #16: measured + 20 %, with the 60 px2 per-slide noise tolerance as the floor). A regression guard, not a target.
